lead_editorial.title: Jio ki shaandaar listing bazaar ke bharose ki jeet hai — par asli imtihaan ab shuru hota hai
lead_editorial.summary: Rs 30,213 crore ka IPO 22 guna subscribe hua aur share 21% premium par list hua. Lekin ek listing-day ki chamak ke baad company ko har quarter apne valuation ko kamaai se sahi saabit karna hoga.
body: Budhvaar ko Jio Platforms ke shares BSE aur NSE par Rs 1,358 par khule — Rs 1,119 ke issue price se lagbhag 21.36% upar. The Tribune ki report ke mutabik listing ke baad company ka market cap lagbhag Rs 12.5 lakh crore pahuncha, jisse yeh desh ki doosri sabse keemti company ban gayi. Issue 22.19 guna subscribe hua tha, jismein institutional investors ka hissa 70 guna se zyada bhara. In aankdon se saaf hai ki desh aur duniya ke bade niveshak India ki digital kahani par daav lagane ko taiyaar hain.

Yeh listing ek aise din aayi jab bazaar ka mood achha nahi tha. HDFC Sky ki market report ke mutabik Saudi refinery par hamle ki khabar ke baad Brent crude $115 ke upar chala gaya, Sensex 353 ank gira aur rupaya 95.23 prati dollar par band hua. Aise maahaul mein itne bade issue ka premium par list hona dikhata hai ki achhi company ke liye paisa ab bhi maujood hai — aur yeh India ke primary market ki gehraai ka bhi sanket hai.

Lekin hamari raay mein listing-day ka josh hi kahani ka ant nahi hai. Itne bade valuation ka matlab hai ki ab niveshak har quarter mein subscriber growth, prati user kamaai aur naye kaarobaar — jaise broadband aur digital services — mein thos pragati dekhna chahenge. Telecom ek regulated sector hai jahan tariff, spectrum aur pratispardha teeno ka asar seedha munafe par padta hai. Chhote niveshakon ko bhi yeh yaad rakhna chahiye ki pehle din ka premium aage ke return ki guarantee nahi hota.

Ek aur pehlu par dhyan dena zaroori hai: ek hi group ki do companiyan ab bazaar ki sabse badi companiyon mein hongi. Isse index aur mutual funds mein unka wazan badhega, aur corporate governance, related-party lenden aur paardarshita par nazar bhi utni hi kadi honi chahiye. Jio ki safalta India ke capital market ke liye achhi khabar hai — bas shart yeh hai ki aage ka safar bhi utna hi khula aur jawabdeh rahe jitna IPO ka prospectus.

stories.title: Cyclone Arnab ka landfall poora, toofan kamzor pada; Andhra mein bijli ke taar se do logon ki maut ki report, Konaseema-Kakinada mein bijli gul
stories.summary: IMD ke mutabik Arnab ne Narsapur ke paas coast cross kiya aur ab poori tarah zameen par hai; Konaseema mein 10,000 se zyada aur Odisha mein 30,000 se zyada log surakshit jagahon par.
body: Very severe Cyclone Arnab ne Budhvaar subah Andhra Pradesh aur Yanam ke coast ko paar kar liya. The Daily Pioneer ki report ke mutabik toofan Narsapur se lagbhag 20 km poorv-uttarpoorv, Yanam se 40 km aur Kakinada se 60 km dakshin-paschim mein coast se guzra. Landfall ke waqt hawa ki raftaar 135 km/h aur jhonke 150 km/h tak the; IMD ke mutabik iske baad yeh kamzor hokar severe cyclonic storm ban gaya aur ab poori tarah zameen par hai. ETV Bharat ke live blog ke mutabik Anakapalli aur Visakhapatnam zilon mein kai jagah 200 mm se zyada baarish darj hui.

Pioneer ki report ke mutabik do logon ki maut bijli ke toote taar ki chapet mein aane se hui — Visakhapatnam zile mein ek 53 varshiya vyakti (Mangalvaar raat) aur Anakapalli ke Yellamanchili mein ek 55 varshiya mahila (Budhvaar subah). Akhbaar ne note kiya ki CM N. Chandrababu Naidu ki official release mein ab tak 'koi jaan ka nuksaan nahi' bataya gaya tha. Kakinada, Konaseema aur Alluri Sitaramaraju ki police ne apne ilaakon mein Budhvaar subah tak koi maut na hone ki baat kahi.

Nuksaan ka akhiri aankda abhi nahi aaya hai. Pioneer ke mutabik Konaseema aur Kakinada mein bijli supply thap hai, saikdon ped aur khambhe gire hain, Kakinada ki coastal Uppada road beh gayi aur Anantagiri mandal mein ek purana pul toot gaya. Bijli bahaali ke liye 6,000 karmchaari lagaye gaye hain. Konaseema mein 10,000 se zyada log 495 shelters mein hain, jabki Odisha ne dakshini zilon se 30,000 se zyada logon ko hataya. CM ne fasal nuksaan ka shuruaati aankalan maanga hai.

stories.title: Kendriya karmchaariyon ko tohfa: Cabinet ne DA aur DR 3% badhakar 63% kiya, 1 July 2026 se laagu
stories.summary: Is faisle par Rs 10,016 crore ka kharch aayega; lagbhag 48 lakh karmchaari aur 68 lakh pensioners ko fayda, arrears bhi milenge.
body: Pradhanmantri Narendra Modi ki adhyakshata mein Union Cabinet ne Budhvaar ko kendriya karmchaariyon ke Dearness Allowance (DA) aur pensioners ke Dearness Relief (DR) mein 3 percentage point ki badhotri ko manzoori di. NewsX ki report ke mutabik isse DA/DR mool vetan ya pension ke 60% se badhkar 63% ho jaayega. Yeh 1 July 2026 se laagu hoga, isliye karmchaariyon ko pichhle mahino ka arrear bhi milega.

Report ke mutabik is badhotri par sarkar ka kul kharch Rs 10,016 crore hoga aur isse lagbhag 48 lakh kendriya karmchaari aur 68 lakh pensioners labhaanvit honge. 6th Central Pay Commission ke scale par chal rahe karmchaariyon aur pensioners ke liye DA/DR 262% se badhkar 269% kiya gaya hai.
DA mehngai ke asar ki bharpaai ke liye saal mein do baar badhaya jaata hai. Yeh faisla aise samay aaya hai jab mehnga kachcha tel aur kamzor rupaya gharelu mehngai par dabav bana rahe hain.

stories.title: MLC chunav mein Congress khaali haath, PM Modi ka tanz — 'ballot paper se hue chunav'; CEC ke 'public impeachment' par BJP-Congress aamne-saamne
stories.summary: Karnataka ki chaar MLC seaton mein teen BJP aur ek JD(S) ko; INDIA bloc 30 October ko CEC Gyanesh Kumar ka 'public impeachment' karne ki taiyari mein.
body: Chaar rajyon — Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar aur Karnataka — ki 28 Legislative Council seaton ke nateejon par PM Narendra Modi ne Budhvaar ko X par Congress par tanz kasa. IANS ki report (Social News XYZ par) ke mutabik unhone likha ki yeh chunav ballot paper se hue the, aur poocha ki 'andaaza lagaiye Congress ne kitni seatein jeetin?' Report ke mutabik Congress teen rajyon mein khaata nahi khol paayi; UP ki Agra Teachers seat Samajwadi Party ne aur Bihar ki Patna Teachers seat RJD ne jeeti.

Karnataka ki chaar seaton mein, Organiser ki report ke mutabik, BJP ne North-East Teachers, West Graduates aur South-East Graduates seatein jeetin, jabki Bengaluru Teachers seat BJP-samarthit JD(S) ke A.P. Ranganath ne Congress ke maujooda MLC Puttanna ko 908 voton se haraakar jeeti.

Isi beech Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar ko lekar siyasi takraav tez ho gaya hai. IANS ke mutabik Congress ne electoral rolls ke Special Intensive Revision (SIR) mein kathit gadbadiyon ko lekar INDIA bloc ka prastaavit 'public impeachment' 30 October ko Mallikarjun Kharge ke sarkari awaas par karne ka faisla kiya hai, aur 1 November ko Ramlila Maidan mein rally hogi. BJP pravakta Tuhin Sinha ne aarop lagaya ki Congress aisi 'mock impeachment' se CEC ke khilaaf hinsa bhadka rahi hai; unhone kaha ki maamla Supreme Court mein lambit hai.

editorial.title: Aapda mein sabse pehle sahi aankde zaroori hain — 'zero casualty' ka daava jaldbaazi na bane
body: Cyclone Arnab ke saamne Andhra aur Odisha ki taiyari kaafi had tak kaamyaab dikhi — hazaron log shelters mein pahunche aur landfall ke baad toofan tezi se kamzor pada. Is mehnat ki taareef honi chahiye.

Lekin hamari raay mein jab media reports bijli ke taar se do mauton ki baat kar rahi hon, tab sarkari release mein 'koi jaan ka nuksaan nahi' likhna bharosa kam karta hai. Toofan ke dauraan aur baad mein bijli ke toote taar sabse bada khatra hote hain; inhe cyclone se judi maut maana jaana chahiye taaki muaavza aur suraksha niyam dono theek se laagu hon.
Ab sabse zaroori hai bijli ki tez bahaali, tooti sadkon aur pulon ki marammat, aur fasal nuksaan ka paardarshi survey. Sahi aankde hi sahi raahat ka aadhaar hain.

stories.title: Israel: 85% vote ginti ke baad bhi kisi bloc ko bahumat nahi; Herzog ne doosre chunav se bachne ki apeel ki, kaha — 'open mind' se aayen
stories.summary: Times of Israel ke mutabik Likud-led bloc 53, Eisenkot-led bloc 48 aur Arab dal 19 seat par; official nateeje agle hafte tak aane ki ummeed.
body: Israel ke Knesset chunav mein ginti aage badhne ke saath tasveer aur ulajh gayi hai. Times of Israel ke live blog ke mutabik 85% se zyada vote gine jaane par Netanyahu-samarthak bloc 53, Gadi Eisenkot ki aguvaai wala bloc 48 aur Arab dal 19 seat par the; ek anya update mein yeh aankde 54, 49 aur 17 bataye gaye. Bahumat ke liye 120 mein se 61 seat chahiye. Ynet ke pehle ke anumaan mein Likud 27 seat ke saath sabse badi party aur Eisenkot ki Yashar! 21 seat ke saath doosre number par thi.

President Isaac Herzog ne Budhvaar ko chunav ke baad apni pehli public tippani mein dalon se doosre chunav se bachne ki apeel ki aur kaha ki sarkar banane ki baatcheet mein sab 'open mind' ke saath aayen. Unhone kaha ki unhe official nateeje agle hafte milne ki ummeed hai, jiske baad woh har faction se salaah karenge. Ynet ke mutabik sainikon samet double-envelope voton ki ginti Shukravaar tak chal sakti hai.

Ynet ke mutabik Netanyahu ne 'Zionist bahumat' se ekjut hone ki apeel ki, jabki Eisenkot ne kaha ki janta ne badlav chuna hai aur Netanyahu se pad chhodne ko kaha. Arab dalon ki record seatein ab coalition ke ganit mein nirnaayak ho sakti hain.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia ki Ras Tanura refinery par Houthi hamle ka daava, Brent crude $115 ke paar
stories.summary: Iran-samarthit Houthi group ne ballistic missile hamle ka daava kiya; Brent lagbhag 1.6% chadhkar $115.70 aur WTI $101.50 par.
body: Yemen ke Iran-samarthit Houthi group ne daava kiya hai ki usne Saudi Arabia ki badi Ras Tanura refinery par 'ballistic missile hamla' kiya. Free Press Journal ki report ke mutabik yeh ek daava hai jiski swatantra pushti nahi hui hai, aur report mein Saudi Arabia ki pratikriya ka zikr nahi hai.

Is khabar ke baad Budhvaar ko tel ke daam phir chadh gaye. Report ke mutabik Brent crude 1.58% badhkar $115.70 prati barrel aur US WTI 1.50% badhkar $101.50 prati barrel par pahuncha. Isi beech US President Donald Trump ne kaha ki Iran ke saath sangharsh Washington ki sharton par khatm hoga aur kisi bhi samjhaute mein Iran ko parmaanu hathiyar se roka jaana chahiye.

India apni zaroorat ka bada hissa tel import karta hai, isliye iska asar seedha yahan dikha. HDFC Sky ki market report ke mutabik mehnge tel ki chinta mein Sensex aur Nifty gire aur rupaya kamzor hokar 95.23 prati dollar par band hua.

editorial.title: Israel ka faisla ab ballot box se nahi, baatcheet ki mez par hoga
body: Ginti lagbhag poori hone ke kareeb hai, phir bhi koi bloc 61 ke aankde ke paas nahi. Herzog ki doosre chunav se bachne ki apeel samajhdaari bhari hai — baar-baar ke chunav ne Israel ki rajneeti ko thaka diya hai.

Hamari raay mein sabse dilchasp pehlu Arab dalon ka record pradarshan hai. Agar koi bhi gathbandhan unke samarthan ke bina nahi ban sakta, to yeh Israel ki loktantrik bahas ka daayra badal sakta hai. Netanyahu ka unke saath sahyog ko galat batana is baat ka sanket hai ki aage ki baatcheet aasaan nahi hogi.
India ke liye Israel ek mahatvapurn raksha aur technology saathi hai. Wahan sthir sarkar — chahe kisi ki bhi ho — West Asia mein tanav kam karne aur vyapar ke liye behtar hogi.

stories.title: Jio Platforms ki dhamakedaar entry: Rs 1,358 par list hua share, issue price se 21% upar; market cap Rs 12.5 lakh crore
stories.summary: 22 guna subscribe hue Rs 30,213 crore ke IPO ke baad Jio desh ki doosri sabse keemti listed company bani.
body: Reliance ki digital company Jio Platforms ke shares Budhvaar ko BSE aur NSE dono par Rs 1,358 par list hue, jo Rs 1,119 ke issue price se 21.36% zyada hai. The Tribune ki report ke mutabik listing ke baad company ka market cap lagbhag Rs 12.5 lakh crore raha, jisse yeh India ki doosri sabse keemti company aur sabse badi telecom company ban gayi.

Rs 30,213 crore ka yeh IPO 21 se 23 October tak khula tha aur kul 22.19 guna subscribe hua. Qualified institutional buyers ka hissa 70.55 guna aur retail hissa 2.72 guna bhara. HDFC Sky ke mutabik listing par company ka valuation lagbhag $131.5 billion raha.

Tribune ke mutabik Anant Ambani ne listing ko aabhaar ka pal bataya aur kaha, 'Aaj Jio India ke saath share ho gaya hai.' Dilchasp yeh raha ki listing ke din parent company Reliance Industries ka share Nifty ke sabse bade gainers ke bajaye losers mein raha aur 3.19% gira.

stories.title: Mehnge tel aur Fed ke intezaar mein Sensex 353 ank gira, Nifty 22,699 par; IT aur oil & gas shares mein bikvaali
stories.summary: Infosys aur Reliance sabse bade losers, Apollo Hospitals aur L&T top gainers; smallcap index phir bhi 0.9% chadha.
body: HDFC Sky ki market report ke mutabik Budhvaar ko Sensex 352.64 ank (0.48%) girkar 73,246.03 aur Nifty 50.90 ank (0.22%) girkar 22,698.85 par band hua. Saudi refinery par hamle ki khabar ke baad Brent ke $115 ke upar jaane aur raat ko aane wale US Federal Reserve ke faisle se pehle niveshak saavdhaan rahe.

Nifty IT aur Oil & Gas index lagbhag 2-2% gire. Infosys (-3.43%), Reliance (-3.19%), ONGC, Tech Mahindra aur Bharti Airtel sabse zyada gire, jabki Apollo Hospitals (+4.43%), L&T (+3.72%), Trent, SBI Life aur InterGlobe Aviation sabse aage rahe. Auto, pharma aur consumer durables lagbhag 1% chadhe.

Bade shares ki kamzori ke baavjood bazaar ki chaudai sakaaratmak rahi — 2,178 shares chadhe aur 1,957 gire. Nifty Midcap 0.4% aur Smallcap 0.9% upar band hue. Rupaya 11 paise kamzor hokar 95.23 prati dollar par band hua.

stories.title: Cabinet ne Rs 10,000 crore ki Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme ko di manzoori, ghar mein container banane ki kshamta 10 guna karne ka lakshya
stories.summary: Scheme se saalana 7.5 lakh TEU kshamta aur 3,000 pratyaksh va 50,000 se zyada apratyaksh naukriyon ka anumaan.
body: Union Cabinet ne Budhvaar ko Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme (CMPS) ko manzoori di. MarineLink ki report ke mutabik scheme ka kul aakaar Rs 10,000 crore (lagbhag $1.05 billion) hai aur iska elaan 2026-27 ke Union Budget mein hua tha.

Report ke mutabik iska maqsad shipping containers ke import par nirbharta ghatana, maritime supply chain ko mazboot karna aur India ko container export hub banana hai. Lakshya gharelu kshamta ko lagbhag das guna badhakar 7.5 lakh TEU saalana karna hai, jisse lagbhag 3,000 pratyaksh aur 50,000 se zyada apratyaksh naukriyan banne ka anumaan hai.

Scheme mein lagbhag Rs 8,891 crore yogya containers par operational sahayta ke liye, Rs 859 crore term loans par 3% saalana byaaj subsidy ke liye aur Rs 150 crore saajha testing aur certification suvidhaon ke liye rakhe gaye hain.

editorial.title: $115 ka tel aur 95 ka rupaya — yeh jodi India ke liye sabse badi chinta hai
body: Jio ki listing ki chamak ke peeche Budhvaar ka asli sandesh tel se aaya. Saudi refinery par hamle ke daave ke baad Brent $115 ke paar gaya aur rupaya 95 ke upar band hua. India jaise bade tel importer ke liye yeh mehngai, current account aur company margins — teeno par dabav ka nuskha hai.

Hamari raay mein sarkar ke saamne mushkil santulan hai: DA badhotri jaise kadam logon ko mehngai se raahat dete hain, lekin agar tel lambe samay tak itna mehnga raha to fuel taxes, subsidy aur ghaate ke beech chunav karna padega. Is waqt sabse zaroori hai ki tel aapoorti ke sroton ko aur vividh kiya jaaye aur strategic reserves ka samajhdaari se istemaal ho.
Niveshakon ke liye bhi yeh yaad dilaane ka waqt hai ki bazaar ki disha aksar Dalal Street se nahi, West Asia aur Washington se tay ho rahi hai. Yeh salah nahi, sirf haalaat ka aaina hai.

stories.title: Vaishnavi Sharma ke paanch wicket, India ki mahila team ne Zimbabwe ko 8 wicket se haraakar ODI series 3-0 se jeeti
stories.summary: Vadodara mein Zimbabwe 131 par simti, India ne lakshya sirf 17 over mein haasil kiya; Pratika Rawal aur Shafali Verma ke ardhshatak.
body: Vadodara mein Budhvaar ko teesre mahila ODI mein India ne Zimbabwe ko 8 wicket se haraakar series 3-0 se apne naam ki. Telangana Today ki report ke mutabik 20 saal ki left-arm spinner Vaishnavi Sharma ne apne teesre hi ODI mein 10 over mein 39 run dekar 5 wicket liye, aur Zimbabwe ki team 39.5 over mein 131 run par all out ho gayi.

Jawab mein India ne sirf 17 over mein 2 wicket par 132 run bana liye. Pratika Rawal ne 56 gend par naabaad 59 aur number 4 par aayi Shafali Verma ne sirf 26 gend par naabaad 51 run banaye. Kranti Gaud aur Sayali Satghare ne do-do wicket liye. Isse pehle India ne T20 series bhi 3-0 se jeeti thi.

Isi din ki doosri cricket khabaron mein, CricTracker ke mutabik WPL 2027 auction Kochi mein shuru hua aur auction pool 146 se badhkar 150 khiladiyon ka ho gaya, jabki Yastika Bhatia ko WBBL mein Brisbane Heat ne chot se bahar hui Jess Jonassen ki jagah shaamil kiya.

stories.title: 'Ramayana' ki advance booking 8 din mein Rs 14.64 crore aur 2.77 lakh tickets tak pahunchi; 5 November ko release
stories.summary: Free Press Journal ne shuruaat ko 'theek-thaak' bataya, jo itni badi film ke anumaanon se kuch kam hai; pehle din Rs 100 crore se zyada ki ummeed.
body: Nitesh Tiwari ki 'Ramayana' ki advance booking 20 October ko shuru hui thi. Free Press Journal ki Budhvaar shaam ki report ke mutabik Sacnilk ke aankdon par aath din mein film ne blocked seats milakar lagbhag Rs 14.64 crore gross aur 2.77 lakh tickets bech liye; blocked seats hataakar yeh aankde Rs 11.88 crore aur 2.22 lakh hain.

Report ne is shuruaat ko theek-thaak bataya, lekin kaha ki film ke paimaane aur budget ko dekhte hue aath din mein Rs 22-27 crore ki ummeed thi. Phir bhi pehle din ki kamaai Rs 100 crore se zyada rehne ka anumaan jataaya gaya hai. Film mein Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi aur Yash hain.

Report ke mutabik do hisson wali is franchise ka kathit budget Rs 4,000 crore hai. Film 5 November ko release hogi; Hyderabad aur Chennai mein promotional events ki yojana hai aur 27 October ko Los Angeles mein ek special screening hui.

image.alt: Abhineta Ranbir Kapoor (April 2024 ki file photo)

stories.title: Report: OpenAI ab Google ke AI chips (TPU) khareedne ki taiyari mein — Nvidia ke liye nayi chunauti?
stories.summary: The Information ki report par OpenAI ne tippani se inkaar kiya, Google ne jawab nahi diya; saude ki sharten saamne nahi aayin.
body: 24/7 Wall St. ke mutabik The Information ne Mangalvaar raat ek vyakti ke hawaale se report kiya ki OpenAI Google ke custom AI chips, yaani Tensor Processing Units (TPU), khareedne ki yojana bana raha hai. Abhi tak kisi bhi company ne iski pushti nahi ki hai — OpenAI ne tippani se inkaar kiya aur Google ne turant jawab nahi diya. Saude ki raashi, maatra ya samay ke baare mein koi jaankari nahi hai.

Report ke mutabik OpenAI ne June 2025 mein Google ke TPU kiraye par lena shuru kiya tha. Agar khareed ki baat sach hoti hai, to yeh Nvidia par OpenAI ki nirbharta kam karne ki disha mein kadam hoga. Usi din OpenAI, Nvidia aur Oracle ne Oracle Cloud par Nvidia ke Vera ko production mein laane ka saajha elaan bhi kiya.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ne bharosa jataaya ki OpenAI lambe samay tak unka graahak aur saathi rahega. Analysis mein yeh bhi kaha gaya ki TPU ka software abhi Nvidia se peeche hai, isliye saude ka asar headline se chhota ya dheema ho sakta hai. Alphabet Budhvaar ko bazaar band hone ke baad apne nateeje jaari karega.

image.alt: Google ka Tensor Processing Unit 3.0 chip (file photo)

editorial.title: Vaishnavi aur Shafali — mahila cricket ki bench strength ab asli taaqat ban rahi hai
body: Zimbabwe ke khilaaf 3-0 ki jeet ko kamzor virodhi ke naam par halke mein lena aasaan hai. Lekin 20 saal ki Vaishnavi Sharma ka teesre hi ODI mein paanch wicket lena aur Shafali ka 26 gend par ardhshatak dikhata hai ki team ke paas naye aur laute hue, dono tarah ke match-winners hain.

Hamari raay mein aisi series ka asli fayda yahi hai — naye khiladiyon ko antarrashtriya anubhav dena aur combinations aazmaana. WPL auction aur WBBL jaise mauke is pratibha ko aur nikhaarenge. Ab chunauti yeh hai ki yahi pradarshan mazboot teamon ke khilaaf bhi dohraaya jaaye.
